releaseStatus.note: 2.5.2 is a release candidate and is not yet available through the public updater feed. Configured official builds show a first-run anonymous-reporting notice and keep the opt-out in Settings; see Privacy.

entities.name: RAV
entities.description: RAV desktop Rive animation viewer. The 2.5.2 release candidate makes file, artboard, playback-target, and ViewModel-instance replacement transactional so the last confirmed frame remains visible until its successor is ready. It adds timeline progress in frames or seconds, reliable warm file opens, two-way scalar/image/list control synchronization, explicit macOS default-app and icon controls, and a final anonymous opt-out status before reporting stops.
